One kit. One problem. Clean paws at the door, every walk.

The enemy is not your dog. It is the mud, the paw prints — and the full bath after every walk.

Wipes smear it around. Towels miss what is packed between the toes. So most owners either mop daily or drag the dog to the tub. PAWDOOR exists to end that choice: fill, dip, twist, dry — the dirt stays in the cup, and your home stays yours.

How it works

Keep the kit by the door. Use it every time you come in. That is the entire routine.

01

Fill with water

Add clean water up to the line. For heavy mud days, a drop of gentle pet soap is optional — most walks need water alone.

02

Insert paw and twist

Guide one paw in and slowly twist the cup back and forth. The soft bristles do the scrubbing while the dirt sinks into the water. Packed-in mud between the toes? The included paw brush knocks it loose first.

03

Dry the paw

Lift the paw out and pat dry with the microfiber towel from the bundle, then repeat. Clean paws walk in — the mud stays in the cup.

Quick questions

What's included in the bundle?

Every order is the full door-routine kit: the PAWDOOR paw cleaner cup with soft silicone bristles, a paw brush for mud packed between the toes, and a microfiber drying towel for the finishing pat-dry. Nothing else to buy — the routine is complete out of the box.

What size should I get?

Measure across the widest part of your dog's paw. Small fits up to 2in, Medium up to 2.5in (most breeds), and Large up to 3in. When in doubt, size up — the bristles do the work, not a tight fit.

Do I need soap?

For everyday dirt and mud, plain water is enough. On heavy-mud days you can add a drop of gentle, pet-safe soap. Rinse the cup out after each use and let it air dry by the door.

How do I clean the cup itself?

Empty the dirty water, pull out the silicone bristle insert, and rinse both parts. Everything goes back together in seconds — and the mud never touches your sink sponge routine for the floors again.

What if my dog will not put a paw in?

Most dogs accept it within a walk or two: let them sniff it dry first, reward after each paw, and keep it calm and quick. The 30-Day Clean-Home Guarantee covers you if your dog simply says no.
